dedupe_keys.name: ceew data portal datasets and dashboards of the council on energy environment and water india

description: The Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW), an independent policy research institute in New Delhi, publishes datasets, dashboards and tools from its research. The data page read on 2026-09-28 lists datasets such as Mapping India's Energy Subsidies 2020, the India Energy Access Dataverse (household survey data on electricity and cooking energy access) and a database of fire incidences in Punjab from 2012 to 2018, alongside a dashboards and tools section, within research themes of energy transitions, power markets, industrial sustainability, clean air, sustainable water, mobility, cooling and climate resilience. Coverage is India, national and by state. Access is free; licences are set per dataset and are not stated on the overview page. Caveats: datasets are research products with their own vintages, some are survey samples, and the portal mixes data with publications. It supports capacity planning and service performance studies of Indian energy access and power supply, and hazard exposure studies from the fire database. No related CEEW record is catalogued; Indian government energy statistics complement it.
